care.summary: Heat-loving pod vegetable for tropical and subtropical summers; needs sun and warm nights.
care.water: Deep watering 1–2× weekly; more in extreme heat
care.soil: Well-drained fertile soil; tolerates light sand with compost
care.fertilizer: Balanced feed at flowering; avoid excess nitrogen
care.toxicity: Pods edible when young; fibers toughen quickly
tips: Sow only after soil is warm
care.climate_notes: Classic subtropical outdoor vegetable; struggles in cool maritime summers.
